title: Slovakian Red Bean Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Slovakian-inspired stew made with red beans, roasted vegetables, and zesty dumplings.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until caramelized, about 20 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the dried red beans, vegetable broth, and Slovakian paprika.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Cook the zesty dumplings according to package instructions.
Serve the stew hot, topped with the cooked dumplings.
